attributes.board_name: Missouri State Committee of Marital and Family Therapists

rules.accepted_credit_types: At least 20 formal hours (workshops, seminars, meetings, online courses with certificate, post-degree graduate coursework at 15 h per semester hour, employer in-service, research presentations); remainder self-study or formal

topics.who: Suicide assessment, referral, treatment and management training

rules.notes: 40 hours per biennial cycle, completed before the license expires (RSMo 337.718.1). Suicide hours count toward the 40.
